subject: Weekly GPU capacity reconciliation & deal-based reservations
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: sara.gomez@stellarretail.com, procurement@stellarretail.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly GPU capacity reconciliation & deal-based reservations

Team — kicking off the weekly sync to reconcile the committed/reserved GPU slots vs the current pipeline for StellarRetail (HB-4782) and a couple of other deals with dedicated asks. Goal: come out of this thread with clear reservation numbers (monthly v. burst), any SLA exceptions we need to approve, and an owner for procurement coordination.

Quick context: 
- StellarRetail is asking to lock 8 reserved slots for Q3 (steady throughput, 12K reqs/day) with 2 additional burstable GPUs for peak events.
- Finance needs an estimate of committed spend by June 1 to include in the FY run-rate.
- Infra needs final reservation specs by May 12 to order capacity and avoid a July shortage.

Please review the attached pipeline snapshot and the draft capacity guidelines I linked. Action items in this message: 
1) Laura: confirm whether 8 reserved + 2 burst is feasible in our current Dedicated pool (and whether it affects other near-term commit windows).
2) Marcus: call out any infra constraints or lead times we should surface to sales/finance.
3) Karthik: if this changes the incentive/discount structure we discussed, flag the finance impact; I can loop in Sarah (finance) if needed.

Attachments: 2027-05-05-pipeline-snapshot.csv, dedicated-capacity-guidelines-v2.pdf

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: sara.gomez@stellarretail.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly GPU capacity reconciliation & deal-based reservations

On Wed, May 5, 2027 at 9:15 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — kicking off the weekly sync to reconcile the committed/reserved GPU slots vs the current pipeline for StellarRetail (HB-4782) and a couple of other deals with dedicated asks.

Jordan — thanks for the summary and for attaching the snapshot. Quick read of the numbers:
- StellarRetail: 8 reserved (A100-equivalent) looks right for their steady RT workload; 2 burstable is reasonable but we should classify those as "burst pool" not guaranteed.
- Impact on commitments: if we accept 8 reserved starting July 1 with a 12-month commit, we need to mark ~192 GPU-months on the Dedicated backlog for Q3/Q4.

Questions / notes: 
- If Infra confirms lead time > 6 weeks to obtain new physical capacity, we need a contingency (canary fallbacks to hosted models or temporary burst credits).
- Do we want to tie the discount to the full 12-month commit or allow a 6-month ramp with a smaller rebate? That’s a finance call.

I’ve attached a small carve-out checklist in the guidelines PDF that says how to categorize burst v. reserved and what Ops needs in the purchase order.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, sara.gomez@stellarretail.com, procurement@stellarretail.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly GPU capacity reconciliation & deal-based reservations

Jordan/Laura — infra notes below: 
- Lead time: current procurement lead time for additional Dedicated capacity (provisioned capacity in our US West cluster) is 7–9 weeks from PO acceptance to being ready in the pool (includes procurement + rack + validation).
- We have 10 uncommitted GPUs in the next maintenance window (June 10–14) but those are already earmarked for internal POC bursts; we could reassign 2 for StellarRetail if sales wants guaranteed availability.
- Autoscale/burst behavior: we recommend provisioning 2 GPUs as "hot-burst" (short-lived pre-warmed instances) rather than full-month reserved. That reduces committed months and gives us flexibility for other deals.

Action: If sales wants a guaranteed July 1 start for 8 reserved GPUs, we need signed purchase terms by May 18 to keep the 7–9 week timeline. If they accept hot-burst + 6-month ramp for two extra GPUs, we can shift the PO window to May 26.

Marcus Lin
VP, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly GPU capacity reconciliation & deal-based reservations

Thanks — quick finance check: if we take 8 reserved GPUs for 12 months at the current reserved price tier, incremental committed spend for StellarRetail is ~$168k/month (est). If we allow 2 as hot-burst only, the commit drops by ~42k/month.

Recommendation: Offer a 10% commit discount for 12-month reserved start date and a 5% ramp discount if they sign for a 6-month ramp with hot-burst. I’ll draft numbers and share with the deal rep; Jordan, let me know if you want me to join the next call.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@stellarretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly GPU capacity reconciliation & deal-based reservations

Thanks everyone — helpful detail. Procurement here (cc'd) confirms internal approval path; we can target a PO by May 20 if Redwood provides the final purchase terms and a short note clarifying burst behavior and fallback SLA.

Next steps per my read: 
- Jordan: update the PO template with the "hot-burst" callout and send a draft to procurement (copied).
- Laura/Marcus: confirm final start date options (July 1 hard start or July with 2 hot-burst ramp).
- Karthik: share the two pricing options (12-month reserved v. 6-month ramp) and I’ll confirm with my CFO.

Attached: none. Happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow if helpful.

Sara Gomez
Head of Platform Engineering | StellarRetail Inc.
